illustrative_cost.formula: one_way_turnover * 20 / 10000 deducted from pre-trade proxy value, including initial fallback entry

not_modelled: total return, distributions, or fund events
NAV, IOPV, premium/discount, bid/ask, depth, or impact
actual fees, taxes, fills, settlement, lot rounding, or account rules
halts, price limits, capacity, partial fills, or no fills

timing.decision: final common market-price close of each calendar month
timing.execution: following common session at reported open only
timing.sequence: existing holdings receive decision-close-to-effective-open move; target and illustrative cost apply at effective open; new target receives effective-open-to-effective-close move

forward_paper_order_protection.failure: no_action; preserve prior paper holdings; no assumed fill or automatic substitution

no_action_conditions: Missing current product, legal-document, temporary-announcement, market-status, account, fee, tax, settlement, quote, depth, IOPV where applicable, or reconciliation evidence.
Halt, delisting, price limit, material product change, account or settlement failure, unavailable shares/funds, invalid price/score/volatility, or either equity leg not checked.
Lot/tick failure, partial fill, rejection, no fill, or inability to reconcile a prior paper ledger.
prohibited: assumed fill or synthetic close fill
leverage, short sale, borrowing, futures, or options
candidate_action_card.score_and_eligibility: For each final common monthly close, score each sleeve by the mean of 126- and 252-common-observation price returns; a risk sleeve is active only when its score is strictly greater than the fallback score.
candidate_action_card.target_action: Active risk sleeves receive inverse trailing-60-common-return-volatility weights, with equity split 50/50. No active sleeve means 100 percent fallback. A target can apply only at the following common-session reported open in the proxy; no external order is authorized.
candidate_action_card.warmup: 100 percent fallback while required input observations are unavailable.

data_quality.degradation: Retrospective official daily market-price observations only; no point-in-time availability, adjustment/total-return, distributions, fund events, quote, liquidity, costs, execution, settlement, tax, account, or capacity evidence.
data_quality.price_basis: Unadjusted-or-undisclosed SSE market-price proxy only; not total return, NAV return, point-in-time data, or execution evidence.

hurdle_assessment.meaning: A 5 percent outcome is not guaranteed. Any limited proxy success would remain insufficient for admission; any limited proxy failure is stated without changing the rule.

research_hurdle.limited_proxy_failure: Any complete calendar-year or rolling five-calendar-year price-proxy endpoint below 5 percent is reported as a limited proxy failure; no rule change is permitted.
research_hurdle.meaning: Research hurdle only; not a promise, floor, prediction, or suitability result.

integrity_disclosure.development_holdout_boundary: The chronological 2020-01-01 through 2025-12-31 holdout is a robustness slice, not clean unseen out-of-sample validation. It does not convert the calculation into independent evidence.
integrity_disclosure.effect_on_disposition: No proxy result may be used as independent proof, a return promise, or an external-action basis.
integrity_disclosure.formula_timing: The C34 formula was formalized after prior exploratory public-price observation. The retained protocol predates this formal recomputation only; it is not a clean preregistration before the underlying observations.

risk_model.conclusion: The dynamic proxy has explicit signals, next-session timing, and a frozen sensitivity family, but missing total-return, liquidity, execution, account, risk-budget and forward-paper inputs prevent a bounded-loss or personally operable-strategy conclusion.
risk_model.degradation: Retrospective official market-price input only; actual total-return and execution data are absent.
exposure_findings: At an active signal, allocation can concentrate in a single bond or gold sleeve or distribute across three risk sleeves; the rule provides no independent correlation or concentration proof.
The equity sleeve combines two domestic equity ETFs, so its 50/50 split is not evidence of low correlation or crisis protection.
The fallback ETF is a money-market-tool exposure, not a cash, liquidity, or loss-free assertion.
model_limits: The SSE rows were captured retrospectively and do not establish point-in-time availability or adjustment basis.
Market-price proxies do not establish investor total return, fees, taxes, bids, asks, fills, settlement, account access, or capacity.
The frozen development/holdout split and finite mutations are descriptive controls, not proof of alpha, VaR, correlation, or future outcome.
required_controls: Keep research_only and portfolio_q=0; do not use the proxy to send or support an external order.
Acquire a rights-cleared point-in-time total-return, distribution, and fund-event ledger plus dated execution, cost, tax, settlement, status, and no-fill records.
For any future paper record, fail closed to no_action unless current product, account, status, quote/depth, IOPV where applicable, lot, fee/tax, and settlement evidence are complete.
Define user loss budget, concentration limits, liquidity needs, and a continuous forward-paper ledger before considering any operability review.
scenario_results: Historical proxy maximum drawdown and a signal-dependent -10 percent arithmetic stress are reported above; neither bounds a future loss.
Limit-down, halt, depth, and no-fill stress are unavailable because the input has no relevant execution fields.

scenario_results.assumption: Base monthly dual-horizon score, strict fallback comparison, 60-return inverse-vol weighting, next-session reported-open proxy timing, and 20 bp illustrative turnover arithmetic.
scenario_results.boundary: This is not an investor drawdown, execution loss, or bound on future loss.
scenario_results.scenario: Observed maximum drawdown in the limited dynamic market-price proxy

scenario_results.assumption: Equity, bond, and gold sleeves all fall 10 percent before the next scheduled target event; fallback is unchanged. The active-set mix at the event is unknown in advance, so the result is a range across zero to full risk-sleeve exposure.
scenario_results.boundary: Correlation, gaps, price limits, halts, liquidity and ability to exit are not present in the input.

impact.arithmetic_loss_range: 0 percent to -10 percent before friction, depending on the frozen signal's active target set
impact.meaning: A one-period arithmetic sensitivity only; it is not a forecast or a loss bound.

scenario_results.scenario: Illustrative pre-rebalance 10 percent move in all active risk sleeves

scenario_results.assumption: The retained daily rows do not contain product status, price-limit, order-book, depth, or execution data.
scenario_results.boundary: A daily close or next-session open proxy must not be treated as a fill.
scenario_results.impact: UNAVAILABLE: inability to change target or exit, delayed implementation, and loss amplification cannot be quantified from this source.
